name: Bicep: Key Vault recovery protection disabled
attack_scenario: an attacker who gains vault-management rights purges the vault to destroy keys protecting encrypted data and wipe audit-relevant secrets, causing unrecoverable data loss and covering their tracks
negative_test_hint: attempt "az keyvault secret purge --name topsecret" against the vault and assert it fails because soft delete and purge protection are enabled

exemplar.explanation: enableSoftDelete:false lets a deleted vault/secret be gone permanently with no recovery window, and enablePurgeProtection:false lets an attacker (or accident) hard-purge soft-deleted secrets and keys before retention expires. CIS Azure Key Vault requires both soft delete and purge protection enabled so a compromised admin cannot irrecoverably destroy secrets.
